Security

Governed by design, not by afterthought.

Every AI action in a SourceWorx product runs through a governed path, so security evidence is a by-product of normal operation, not a quarterly scramble.

Request our security pack →

Trust principles

Least access

Agents and users see only the data their role and task require.

In-path enforcement

Policies are checked as each request runs, so they can't be bypassed.

Evidence by default

Tamper-evident lineage of what ran, on what data, and why.

Your data stays yours

No customer data is used to train shared models.

Data handling and compliance posture

Regional hosting with sovereignty rules that keep regulated workloads in-region. Encryption in transit and at rest.
